Shared and student frontend evidence

These six primary sources were opened for this handoff on 2026-11-04. They inform specific behavior references; the W01-W34 route templates, fields, validation limits and proposed product rules remain Whiteboard planning decisions. Vendor documentation establishes documented capability, not usability, demand, implementation readiness or an integration commitment. The local concept is fictional and has no production authentication, uploads, grades, delivery service or AI inference.

Local authority and lineage

  • CLAUDE.md, NOTES.md and HANDOFF.md distinguish fictional design work from production implementation.
  • design/decisions.md supplies accepted status vocabulary and authority boundaries: D6-D10 submission/privacy/dates; D14-D16 invitation/onboarding/account; D19 preview; D25-D31 grading/release/quiz; D34-D36 roles/allowances; D54-D55 search/help; D59 no direct messaging.
  • design/reviews/academic-scope-review-2026-11-04.md identifies gaps in learner grades, grading policy, groups, private planning, staff calendars, tools and academic communication.
  • showcase/app_map/screens.json and routes.json establish legacy academic lineage and handoffs. Batch 01 student, Batch 02 access, Batch 03 learner/grading and Batch 06 tools sources provide actual prior local page behavior.
  • handoff/academic-webapp-2026-11-04/data/fixtures.json and spec/04_WORKFLOWS_AND_RECORDS.md define canonical new-handoff identities and arithmetic scenarios. The primary PHYS 110 course uses Assignments 40%, Labs 25%, Quizzes 35%. Separate method/policy test scenarios must not replace that default.

The existing accepted 50 destinations and 100 web/planned-iPhone targets remain intact. W01-W34 are proposed academic web route templates for an external HTML-first developer handoff; mapping multiple W pages to one S/P ID records lineage and does not revise legacy counts, acceptance or routes.

Decisions still requiring later institutional input

The first institution/IdP, retained-course access periods, production entitlement source, event publication owner, supported-browser/file limits, emergency quiz recovery and final grade-policy details need partner validation. The page specifications use explicit proposed defaults and failure paths so HTML can demonstrate them without inventing those agreements. Optional self-enrollment appears only when explicitly enabled; instructor-assigned groups remain valid without it. The stricter course/assessment AI policy always governs academic use.

No private PDF was browsed or uploaded for this work. No external message, service, product implementation or accessibility/browser acceptance was performed. This pass opened public sources and produced planning artifacts only.
